title: Failure: an invalid TOML spec is rejected
summary: Submits a job whose TOML does not parse. It must be rejected: either refused at submit or failed by the worker with a parse error that points at the bad line, and it must never produce a COMPLETED run.

steps.title: Submit the broken TOML
steps.explain: The API is what a console or script would call.

steps.title: Wait for the task to finish
steps.explain: The worker parses the TOML; the task result records the outcome.

steps.title: Task is FAILED
steps.explain: A spec that does not parse cannot run.

steps.title: Error points at the bad line
steps.explain: The user must be told where the spec is broken.

steps.title: No run record was written for it
steps.explain: Nothing ran, so history must not show a completed run.
